mappings.note: Three-chambered hearts and the functions of lymph are CIRCULATION, i.e. Life Processes content printed in the Control and Coordination chapter. Neither outcome under C 3.2 reaches it (LO-4 is the reflex arc, LO-5 is hormones) and no other competency is closer: C 3.1 is neuron structure, C 4.2 is brain vs spinal cord and plant tropisms. C 3.2's own text names 'transport (transport of water in plants; circulation in animals)' explicitly, so the competency is the most specific TRUE statement available and the outcome level is unreachable for this item. Its stored concept tag 'Brain Divisions and Functions' is wrong for the same reason the codes are hard: the question does not belong to this chapter.
